title: tidyvisor: A Statistical Adviser for Tidy Ecological Analyses
description: tidyvisor is an R package that gives advice before an ecological analysis and explains the results after it, in plain sentences and with its reasons. It is shared by tidydiversity (community ecology) and tidymapr (spatial ecology), which register their advisers with it.
